notes: Copy this file to scope.json and set authorized to true only after you hold written authorization. capabilities are explicit opt-ins, each unlocking tools that are otherwise blocked before execution: aggressive (masscan, naabu, high-rate scans), credential_testing (hydra), external_agents (Strix, PentAGI, Sn1per), destructive (reserved). allow_passive_sources enables subfinder's third-party sources. allowed_wordlists and allowed_nuclei_templates are exact paths for ffuf/nuclei; files under the local kali wordlist and nuclei-template directories are accepted without listing.
